name: Gamma MCP
description: Generate presentations, documents, webpages, and social posts in Gamma from an MCP client, then edit them and export to PDF, PPTX, or PNG. For anyone making decks.

skills.name: Generate Gammas
skills.description: Generates presentations, documents, webpages, or social posts with control over tone, audience, images, themes, and layout.

skills.name: Generate From A Template
skills.description: Creates a new gamma from an existing template, adapting its cards and layouts to new content, audience, topic, or use case.

skills.name: Edit Existing Gammas
skills.description: Edits an existing gamma from a natural-language instruction, rewording, restructuring, adding, or removing content on a page.

skills.name: Export To PDF, PPTX, Or PNG
skills.description: Exports a gamma to PDF, PPTX, or PNG in the background and returns the download link once the export finishes.

skills.name: Search And Read Gammas
skills.description: Searches gammas by title and body text and reads the full content of a presentation or document from its file ID or URL.
